title: T1565.003 — Data Manipulation - Runtime Data Manipulation
subtitle: The scenario is called "Patched while it runs" .

steps.title: Foothold on the reporting host
steps.caption: A finance user opens a phishing payload. It runs as that user from a temp folder. The file on disk is new and unsigned, but no antivirus rule fires yet
steps.defender: Edge, DNS and network-flow telemetry provide the first reliable evidence.

steps.caption: The attacker's tool calls OpenProcess against the running accounting application (finapp.exe) and asks for full rights, including write to memory. Sysmon Event 10 records the pair and the requested rights (GrantedAccess 0x1FFFFF)
steps.defender: Edge, DNS and network-flow telemetry provide the first reliable evidence.

steps.title: EDR catches the tampering
steps.caption: The EDR sensor correlates the ProcessAccess with write rights and the remote thread into the business application and raises an alert. Neither event belongs to any allowlisted software pair

steps.caption: The analyst captures a triage memory image before remediation. Forensic analysis finds the injected region and the patched values, and compares them with the database. The mismatch proves runtime manipulation
